description: Finds stages by code (1-7, S2-12, YW-4; full-width characters work too), by stage ID (main_01-07), or by the name or ID of their zone (第十章, Under Tides), and returns their stage IDs (for get_stage_drops; to find the stages that drop an item, use get_item_drop_rates) with their zone, sanity cost and whether they are open on the server now. Codes are not unique: the standard and tough versions of a stage of the main story share them, as do an event, its rerun and the stages it left open for good. Best matches first (the code before the zone, exact before prefix before substring), then the stages open now, standard before tough, original before permanent before rerun. ambiguous is true when several stages share the best-matching code (not for the stages of a zone found by its name): ask the user which one is meant or decide by context.

lang.description: Language of the names in the result: the language the user writes in, zh, en, ja or ko (en for other languages, and if omitted).

limit.description: Most stages to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

query.description: Code or ID of the stage, or the name or ID of its zone, in any language: 1-7, S2-12, main_01-07, 第十章 or Under Tides

server.description: Game server the user plays on: CN (China), US (global, English), JP (Japan) or KR (Korea). Default CN. The stages open there now rank first.

name: search_stages

ambiguous.description: Whether several stages share the code (or ID) that matched best: the standard and tough versions of a stage, or an event, its rerun and the stage it left open; ask which one is meant, or pick by context, rather than take the first. False when the query matched a zone: its stages are listed.

results.description: The stages found, best match first

apCost.description: Sanity cost of a run; null without one (gachas, the recruitment)

code.description: Code in the language asked for

difficulty.description: normal, or tough: the tough version of a stage of the main story, with the same code

existsOn.description: Game servers the stage exists on

matchType.description: How matchedText matched the query: exact, prefix or substring

matchedBy.description: What matched the query: id (of the stage), code (in any language) or zone (its name in any language, or its ID)

openNow.description: Whether the stage is open on the server now, by the open and close times of the stage and its zone; supply and chip stages (zoneType WEEKLY) count as open every day, as their weekday rotation is not tracked

pageUrl.description: Page of the drops of the stage on Penguin Statistics, on the server or else the first server it exists on; null if there is none

variant.description: original, rerun (the stage of the rerun of an event) or permanent (the stage an event left open for good)

zoneName.description: Name of the zone in the language asked for

zoneType.description: MAINLINE (the main story), ACTIVITY (an event), ACTIVITY_PERMANENT (a side story or intermezzo, open for good), WEEKLY (supplies and chips), GACHABOX or RECRUIT

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

truncated.description: Whether more stages match than the limit

title: Search stages
